title: Crypto misuse: kcapi AEAD set_tag accepts truncated auth tags
description: kcapi_aead set_tag at src/providers/kcapi/kcapi_aead.c:189 accepts taglen from 1 to GCM_TAG_SIZE with no minimum enforcement. Same as wolfssl GCM finding. Trigger: caller sets taglen=4, kcapi accepts, GCM processes with 4-byte tag. Outcome: authentication strength reduced from 128 bits to 32 bits, enabling tag forgery attacks. Both wolfssl and kcapi must enforce taglen >= 12.
